Hi Liz / Tom 

Thanks again for taking the time earlier for the discovery  I appreciated the context on checkout latency and the team’s desire to reduce per-transaction inference cost. Attached are a couple quick artifacts from our call: a short product brief and the notes I took (redwood-product-brief.pdf, acme-discovery-notes.docx).

Next best step from our side is a technical demo + architecture sync where we can:
- show a short 2025m demo of Redwood on a sample checkout workload
- walk through deployment options (hosted vs dedicated) and latency/cost tradeoffs
- allocate 1015m for your infra/ops folks to ask integration/security questions

I know schedules are tight  are any of these times good for you next week (PST)? If one works, please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite immediately and loop in engineering: 

 Tue Aug 4  10:0011:00 AM PT
 Tue Aug 4  3:003:45 PM PT (shorter slot)
 Wed Aug 5  11:0011:45 AM PT
 Thu Aug 6  9:3010:15 AM PT

If none of those work, tell me 2 windows that do and I’ll align on our side. Real quick ask: given last-minute conflicts earlier this quarter, can you confirm by EOD Monday so we can lock in engineer time?

Thanks  looking forward to continuing the conversation.


